facts.fact: The OGP Malawi Secretariat announced on 2025-09-03 that Malawi had officially launched its new Open Data Portal, giving citizens access to government budget, development project and public service delivery data through dashboards and downloadable datasets, as part of the Third OGP National Action Plan; the document names no publishing ministry or dataset count and does not tie the portal to an open data policy.

facts.fact: A CSEA policy brief of November 2025 finds that Malawi's open data vision is spread across other instruments, with no dedicated open data implementation framework and no central authority to enforce open standards.
The same brief states that no centralised open data portal or standardised framework currently exists, and that most government datasets stay in PDF reports; it proposes a unified portal.

note: The project's policy framework is its own, not a government open data policy.
